pairs.statement: The parties may appear of their own choice before a judge who is not territorially competent.
The subject-matter and territorial rules of the items on bankruptcy and companies and on intellectual property of the article it names stay in force until the specialised poles are installed.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT cites Article 40(3) and (4), but does not identify their subjects as bankruptcy/company disputes and intellectual property.

pairs.statement: The social section has exclusive jurisdiction over social-security and retirement disputes.
A foreigner, even not resident in Algeria, may be summoned before the Algerian courts to perform obligations he contracted in Algeria with an Algerian.
The judge is then competent for the whole proceedings, and on appeal the competence extends to his judicial council.
In mixed actions, the court where the property is situated has jurisdiction.
The Supreme Court names the competent court, which may not then decline jurisdiction.
A kafala application is made to the family judge of the court of the applicant's domicile.
The new subject-matter and territorial rules for the administrative courts and specialised commercial courts apply from the date the new courts are installed.
When a judge is defendant, his opponent may file before a court of the nearest council neighbouring the council where the judge serves.
Limitation is interrupted by a judicial claim, even a claim brought before a court that lacks jurisdiction.
For costs of proceedings and court assistants' fees, the court that decided the original claim has jurisdiction; for guarantee claims, the court seised of the original claim.
The social section has exclusive jurisdiction over the performance, suspension and ending of employment, training and apprenticeship contracts.
For guardianship over a minor's property, the court of the place where guardianship is exercised has jurisdiction.
The administrative courts and commercial sections keep the claims filed before them before the installation.

In commercial matters other than bankruptcy and judicial settlement, the court of the place of the promise, of delivery of the goods, or where payment is due has jurisdiction; in claims against a company, the court where a branch of it lies.
For taxes and duties, the claim must be brought before the administrative court of the place where the tax or duty is imposed.
The plaintiff may not raise the plea of territorial incompetence.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not identify «هذا الدفع» as a plea of territorial incompetence.

pairs.statement: For guardianship, the court of the place where guardianship is exercised.
For the social section, the court of the place where the employment contract was made or performed, or of the defendant's domicile, has jurisdiction.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not say that this rule applies to the social section.

pairs.statement: For maintenance, the court of the maintenance creditor's domicile.
When the employment contract was ended or suspended because of a work accident or occupational illness, the court of the plaintiff's domicile has jurisdiction.
A judge who is plaintiff in a claim belonging to a court of the council where he serves must file it before a court of the nearest neighbouring council.
For the real-property section, the court where the property lies has jurisdiction, unless the law provides otherwise.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not identify the real-property section as the section to which this rule applies.

pairs.statement: Lack of subject-matter jurisdiction is of public order, and the court declares it of its own motion at any stage.
If the courts belong to the same council, the petition goes to that council, which names the competent court and sends the case to it.
Estate claims go to the court of the deceased's domicile, even if some estate property lies outside its district, unless the law provides otherwise.
For compensation of damage from a felony, misdemeanour, minor offence or tort, and for claims for damage caused by the administration, the court where the harmful act occurred has jurisdiction.
A divorce claim by either spouse is brought before the family section by petition.
In disputes between employer and employee, the court of the place where the employment contract was made or performed, or of the defendant's domicile, has jurisdiction.
Claims in the matters listed after it are brought before the courts named there; the paragraph does not use the words of exclusivity used in the next article.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not show that the next article uses exclusivity wording.

pairs.statement: On pain of inadmissibility in form, the petition states the plaintiff's domicile, the defendant's domicile or last domicile, and the registered office of a legal person.
When the employment contract was ended or suspended because of a work accident or occupational illness, the court of the plaintiff's domicile has jurisdiction.
In attachment, whether leave to attach or later steps, the court of the place of attachment has jurisdiction.
For proof of marriage, the court of the defendant's domicile has jurisdiction.
He may also be summoned for obligations he contracted abroad with Algerians.
A conflict of jurisdiction exists when several courts rule on the same dispute that they are competent, or that they are not.
In disputes on supplies, works and hire of technical or industrial services, the court of the place where the agreement was made or performed has jurisdiction, even if a party does not reside there.
The request for an order to pay is made to the president of the court of the debtor's domicile.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not identify the creditor's petition as a request for an order to pay.

pairs.statement: For divorce or return, the court of the place of the marital home; for divorce by mutual consent, the court of the residence of either spouse, as they choose.
By way of exception to that rule, claims in the matters listed after it must be brought before the administrative courts named there.
The paragraphs of the code's article on the composition of the court that created the specialised poles are repealed.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not say that Article 32 concerns the court's composition or that its repealed paragraphs created specialised poles.

pairs.statement: Subject-matter and territorial jurisdiction of the administrative courts are of public order.
A third party brought into the proceedings may not raise territorial incompetence, even relying on a jurisdiction clause.
The specialised commercial court applies this code's territorial rules.
An Algerian may be summoned before the Algerian courts for obligations he contracted abroad, even with a foreigner.
A conservatory attachment is ordered on petition by the president of the court of the debtor's domicile or of the place of the assets to be attached.
For breaking off an engagement, the court of the defendant's domicile has jurisdiction.
For custody, visitation rights and administrative permits for the child in custody, the court of the place where custody is exercised.
In medical services, the court of the place where treatment was given has jurisdiction.
For disputes of civil servants, State agents and staff of public administrative bodies, the claim must be brought before the administrative court of the place where they exercise their functions.
Any party may plead lack of jurisdiction at any stage, and the judge must raise it of his own motion.

In inheritance, divorce or return, custody, maintenance and housing, the courts of, respectively, the deceased's domicile, the marital home, the place where custody is exercised, the maintenance creditor's domicile and the place of the dwelling have jurisdiction.
Territorial jurisdiction of the administrative courts follows the rules on the defendant's domicile and on several defendants.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT cites Articles 37 and 38 without stating their rules on the defendant's domicile and several defendants.

pairs.statement: The subject of the dispute may be changed by incidental requests connected with the original claims.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not identify the object referred to by «تعديله» as the subject of the dispute.

pairs.statement: In urgent matters, the court of the place of the difficulty of execution or of the measures sought has jurisdiction.
Procedural pleas are raised together before any defence on the merits or plea of inadmissibility, failing which they are inadmissible.
The plea of territorial incompetence must be raised before any defence on the merits or plea of inadmissibility.
The judge may give way of his own motion when he finds that the same dispute is pending elsewhere.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT says «إذا تبين له وحدة الموضوع» but does not state that the same dispute is pending before another court.

pairs.statement: Any clause giving territorial jurisdiction to a court that is not competent is void and without effect, unless it was made between traders.
Besides the rules on the defendant's domicile, several defendants and voluntary appearance, claims in the matters listed after it are brought before the courts named there and no other.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not state that Articles 37, 38 and 46 concern the defendant's domicile, several defendants and voluntary appearance.

pairs.statement: For authorisation to marry, the court of the applicant's place.
The party pleading territorial incompetence must give reasons and name the court before which the claim should be brought.
For compensation of damage from a felony, misdemeanour or tort, the claim must be brought before the administrative court of the place of the harmful act.

The court of the defendant's domicile has territorial jurisdiction; if he has no known domicile, the court of his last domicile; if a domicile was elected, the court of the elected domicile; unless the law provides otherwise.
The petition to resolve the conflict is filed within a period running from the formal notification of the last judgment to the losing party.
The commercial section applies this code's territorial rules and those of the Commercial Code, the Maritime Code and special texts.
In bankruptcy or judicial settlement of companies and disputes between partners, the court of the place where the proceedings were opened or of the company's registered office has jurisdiction.
With several defendants, the court of the domicile of any of them has territorial jurisdiction.
In disputes on correspondence, registered items, declared-value consignments and postal parcels, the court of the sender's or the addressee's domicile has jurisdiction.
The judge decides the plea by a judgment, and may decide it together with the merits in the same judgment after telling the parties orally to present their claims on the merits.
The petition must name the court before which the claim is brought, failing which it is inadmissible in form.
Liability claims for damage caused by a vehicle of the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body belong to the ordinary courts.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not say that these claims belong to the ordinary courts.

pairs.statement: For administrative contracts, the claim must be brought before the administrative court of the place the contract was made or performed.
Connection exists when cases before different courts or benches are so related that justice requires them to be heard and decided together.
The parties sign a declaration asking to litigate there; if they cannot sign, that is noted.

The family section hears in particular claims on engagement, marriage, return, dissolution of marriage and its consequences, maintenance, custody and visitation, proof of marriage and filiation, kafala, and guardianship, its loss, interdiction, absence, disappearance and curatorship.
If they belong to different councils, the petition goes to the civil chamber of the Supreme Court.
For the household goods, the court of the place of the marital home.
In urgent cases, judicial custody and protective measures not governed by special procedures, the case is brought before the court in whose district the difficulty or the measure sought lies.
Claims to recognise filiation or to deny paternity are brought before the court of the defendant's domicile.
pairs.missingOrWrong: For recognition of filiation, the TEXT specifies «لشخص مجهول النسب»; it does not state the rule for recognition claims generally.

pairs.statement: In intellectual property, the court sitting at the seat of the judicial council in whose district the defendant's domicile lies has jurisdiction.
The court last seised of the same dispute must give way to the other court when a party asks.
For public works, the claim must be brought before the administrative court of the place where the works are carried out.
For a dowry dispute, the court of the defendant's domicile.

In real-property matters, works on real property, lease claims on buildings including commercial leases, and public works, the court where the property lies or where the works are carried out has jurisdiction.
